name: Dark Star Incident
operational_summary: The Judicator Prime Task Group responded to an apparent mining-vessel distress event in the Lethan system, encountered cloaked hostile ships and an approaching unidentified fleet, launched a forward naval attack, deployed a Ranger-Sentinel boarding team into the concealed vessel, and conducted a separate Sentinel raid against the hostile command flagship operationally designated Crown Dark.
canonical_sequence: Lifeline Six came under fire while approaching the vessel presented as M.V. Carpathia.
Cloaked hostile craft defended the concealed vessel and a larger force converged on the location.

Captain Alric Tann ordered Forward Hammer, committing Judicator Prime, Watchfire, Shieldwake, and the naval aerospace wing to a forward attack while Continuance preserved the task group's endurance reserve.
G.U.S. Third Measure rendezvoused with Kestrel Detachment under a mission-specific Marshal-Sentinel coordination order and boarded the concealed vessel.
The boarding party encountered Shadow Fleet boarders, active vessel material, an older captive Marshal, and an artifact translated as the Third Silence.

Sentinel High Command authorized four twelve-person detachments for direct vacuum insertion against Crown Dark; Tann controlled launch geometry, fleet support, and recovery while Sentinel leads controlled internal assault doctrine.
Harrier, Anvil, Cinder, and Talon entered Crown Dark, disrupted its distributed command architecture, extracted living operators, and captured Eira / Valkyrie.
Crown Dark collapsed during the operation and the Shadow Fleet lost centralized coordination.
All 48 deployed Sentinels were recovered alive.
Ranger and Kestrel personnel remained engaged inside the concealed vessel at the end of the current record.

sentinel_action.survivability_note: Sentinel survivability derived from layered shielding, sacrificial armor, autonomous stabilization, independent life support, recovery beacons, adaptive tactics, and concentrated task-group rescue support.

command_authority.naval: Captain Alric Tann commanded task-group maneuver, combat support, launch geometry, recovery conditions, and emergency safety.
command_authority.sentinel: Sentinel Mission Control and Sentinel High Command authorized the Crown Dark detachments and retained authority over suit doctrine, detachment tactics, personnel decisions, and classified methods.
command_authority.marshal: Marshal-Captain Elias Drayen authorized Third Measure's investigative mission; Tessa Korr retained investigative authority while Major Elias Radek coordinated immediate assault action inside the concealed vessel.
command_authority.judicial: Commander Lyra Voss imposed an emergency evidence-preservation hold on Eira's compartment; Field Judge Aveline Soryn issued the binding judicial sealing and preservation order.

canon_observations: Shadow Fleet vessels possessed operational cloaking or concealment systems.
Crown Dark functioned as a distributed fleet-command platform.
The concealed vessel used segmented internal signal and material domains of approximately thirty-seven meters in observed areas.
The Third Silence artifact altered or interrupted active material behavior within the concealed vessel.
Kallis Foundry evidence displayed engineering similarities to the isolation artifact.
An older Marshal prisoner and erased or missing Union records are connected to the concealed vessel.
staging_hypotheses: The concealed vessel is definitively a prison.
Captive bodies are definitively containment locks.
The Shadow Fleet's complete strategic purpose was to restore containment.
Union personnel intentionally opened the dark star eleven years earlier.
Calder Vey was constructing a replacement isolation command.
The dark star's origin, creators, age, nature, and degree of consciousness.
Eira's claims concerning prior Union responsibility.
source_refs: owner-authored narrative chapters The Dark Star and Valkyrie, 2026-07-22
notes: Observable events and corrected continuity are CANON. Historical interpretation and the true nature of the dark star remain STAGING.
